chunks: And graceful maidens of the same age,

key_terms.أَتْرَابًا: Of the same age or contemporaries

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'kawa'ib atrab' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'atraban' (of similar age) signifies not merely chronological equality but a harmonious spiritual and physical maturity, reflecting the perfection of the soul's state in Jannah. This uniformity underscores the absence of discord or disparity among the inhabitants of Paradise, aligning with the concept of 'kawa'ib' (graceful virgins) as a reward tailored to human desire in its purest form.
